title: MSQA: Benchmarking LLMs on Graduate-Level Materials Science Reasoning and Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-as-a-judge behavior by comparing GPT-4o-mini's ratings against GPT-4o and human annotations to identify a tendency to incorrectly rate longer inference responses as accurate.
Analyzing the distribution of synthetically generated binary-answer questions to identify a pronounced model tendency to generate 'True' over 'False' responses.
